segments.source: The current Z10 NAB has a clear reason to sit above JURA's hot-drink machines: Cold Extraction belongs alongside its Hot, Light and Sweet preparations. Four profiles, included connectivity and the electronically controlled grinder make those options more useful in a varied household than a long menu alone would be. The price asks whether cold drinks and personalization will be regular habits, not occasional demonstrations. Its milk system and closed brew platform still require the specified care. First-generation Z10 material offers some visual context, but the current North American model's grinder, software and recipe capabilities need their own evidence.
